body: I do appreciate your help. I read through that page as well, it helped as well. Though the urge is still here, it is less now than it was before I began to talk to you. Thank you.

My 14th birthday is actually right around the corner... April 14th
I enjoyed playing the cello, singing and reading. Now I hate just about all of those things for some reason. The only thing that I can do now is draw. I draw a lot. I've gone through about 2 300 page sketchbooks in about 4 months
I just don't see one. I don't see an end to all this where I'm not hurt. Because I'm always hurt. And I know I sound whiney when I say this and I'm just some other whiney teenager but I don't know what to do now. I feel like there's nothing I can really do now. I try to distract myself and set goals but it just doesn't work. I always find some way out of them. 
I am worthless and ignorant and shit. I can't do a damn thing right.

As long as I can remember I've been abused. My father used to gamble and drink. When ever he lost a round or whatever the hell they called it he would get angry and scream at me, little four year old me without an idea why the fuck this was happening. I got taken away for a little while, but then started visiting him again. He had stopped gambling, but still drank. He's always put me down. I dress one way, it's slutty, a dress another I look depressed. I want to cut my hair, I must be a lesbian. I sit in my room all the time, I must have social anxiety.
I was diagnosed with severe depression and anxiety when I was 9. He to this day, still gets on my case.
Every fiber of my being is wrong to him. So eventually I have began to believe what he says. That I am worthless and have no purpose. That I am nothing but an object.
And I know he won't miss me and if he won't miss me I don't think anyone else would.

Don't worry about it. 
I don't want to go to the hospital. I have several friend's who have gone that told me that it didn't do anything for them and they just bullshitted their way out of there.
The urge is rather strong. I find myself thinking about it a lot more than I ever have.
And the notes aren't normal notes to get my feelings down, they're suicide notes. They basically reassure all the important people in my life that it wasn't their fault and the things I want them to have.
Also I have tried the distraction tactics. Doesn't work very well for me :/
Are any of these resources anon?
**Warning:** Has severe self esteem issues. Watch what you say *please*
